cases.explanation: Independent route uses stored full-edge distances where the combined graph may split those edges. Virtual distances are recalculated from geometry; duration is truncated per edge. All edge and turn contributions below are recomputed from the actual selected directed paths. Different raw edges may align only if BaseGraph.forEdgeAndCopiesOfEdge proves their shared upstream copy family; both actual paths must remain legal with unchanged turn costs and weight per metre. Unrelated parallel edges never align.
